provider_metadata.note: This is the development assistant that wrote the checker, self-reported from the session environment and not independently verified. It is not a product model and it made no product inference call.

risks_and_open_items: The checker is a deterministic plan-structure check. It does not close the 22 adjudication findings (F1/M1-M11/m1-m10, all still PENDING_RECHECK) and it is not the independent recheck.

The 12 clips / 47 shots / 21 hard cuts / 18 quality rows stay a design allocation. No media, licence, source SHA, PTS index or annotation hash is frozen; the E_SAMPLE_MATERIALIZED guard keeps the placeholders pending and forbids pretending the fixtures exist.

The 20735 s checkpoint estimate is recomputed from the declared design thresholds (300/180 s). It is not a measured per-shot P95 and not a worst-case guarantee; only a representative pilot can confirm the budget.
The candidate migration SQL was not executed by this checker. The root in-memory probe passed, but the real R1 migrator against the product baseline is still unproven.

The MS cases, the V1-M1 stage and R22 are pinned to NOT_RUN. These guards must be re-frozen by the authority when a real checkpoint legitimately produces a PASS; they are expected to fail closed until then.
On a host without jsonschema the metaschema probe and the retained-frame instance probe degrade to the structural fallback; the instance finding would then only cover the required field names.

The overlay and the effective merged OpenAPI are still design candidates. No build-time merge was executed here, so a component reference that only resolves after merging would not be seen by this checker.
The parent deadline formula (450*n+90) is verified as a formula, not as a runtime guarantee that 12 shots always fit inside 5490 s.
The D0 stage control still forbids product execution and Stage PASS. Nothing in this workpack changes the current 621b1bf slice signature state.
